title: Fuse element overload
line: A Joule heating FEA study of a copper fuse element at a 120 A overload, with resistivity rising with temperature.
description: A copper fuse element (10 mm long, 1 x 0.25 mm section) carrying a 120 A overload, its ends held at 20 C by the terminals. Resistivity rises with temperature, so the middle heats faster than the ends. The study solves current and temperature together and returns the peak temperature, against the closed-form solution for resistivity linear in temperature.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature along a copper fuse element at 120 A, hottest at its middle, solved in RunMat
